name: Vasad (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of blue and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Vasad: a green oval with a white horse and a fleur-de-lis within a yellow frame, above a scroll inscribed VASAD.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Vasad arms with frame and scroll
